name: Zizaran
noteEs: Uno de los creators más respetados y veteranos de Path of Exile. Su contenido va desde guías de builds y análisis profundos de mecánicas de league hasta la organización de eventos comunitarios masivos como las Gauntlet Races. Su enfoque didáctico lo hace especialmente accesible para jugadores intermedios que quieren mejorar.
noteEn: One of the most respected and veteran Path of Exile creators. His content ranges from build guides and deep league mechanics analysis to organizing massive community events like the Gauntlet Races. His educational approach makes him especially accessible to intermediate players looking to improve.
highlightsEs: Guías de builds detalladas con explicación pedagógica
Cobertura completa de cada nueva league con day-1 y day-2 streams
Organización de Gauntlet Races, eventos competitivos comunitarios
highlightsEn: Detailed build guides with pedagogical explanations
Complete coverage of each new league with day-1 and day-2 streams
Organization of Gauntlet Races, competitive community events
